sectors.trend: Oil surges on US-Iran tit-for-tat strikes near Hormuz; Trump pressures refiners to ease pump prices; Venezuela oil dealmaking intensifies but SPR replenishment called 'fantasy'
sectors.implications: Sustained oil above current levels will keep inflation sticky, forcing Fed hawkishness and pressuring rate-sensitive sectors. Refiner margins compressed by political pressure.

sectors.trend: AI security (PANW) and AI-driven software (GitLab) beat; Broadcom needs Nvidia-caliber earnings to halt $520B skid; Apple transitions to Ternus CEO; OpenAI legal pressure from Apple; Citi recommends buying tumbling tech
sectors.implications: AI theme remains structurally strong but rotation from chips to software continues. Apple leadership change adds uncertainty. Valuation gaps in mega-cap tech create selective entry points.

sectors.trend: 10Y Treasury at highest since 2023; European/UK bond selloff on gas prices; Fed's Barr backs rate hike; CD rates at 4.30% APY; mortgage rates up double digits
sectors.implications: Higher-for-longer rate environment pressures equities, real estate, and growth stocks. Bond yields offer attractive income but carry reinflation risk if war escalates.

sectors.trend: Gold, silver, and crypto fall despite war as rate-hike expectations dominate; corn drops on profit-taking; Brazilian beef hits EU regulatory wall; Norwegian hydro stocks at record low
sectors.implications: Real-yield-driven metal weakness is counterintuitive but signals market prioritizing rate path over safe-haven flows. Agri-commodities face supply-side regulatory headwinds.

sectors.trend: Grocery bills set to rise faster; EV charging costs climbing; Costco shuts key service; Denny's rival files Chapter 11; Labor Day sales offer discount window
sectors.implications: Consumer squeeze intensifies from energy and food inflation. Discretionary spending under pressure; value and discount retailers benefit.

sectors.trend: India records $127B diaspora forex inflows; Zerodha gains merchant banking license; BYD export volumes rival Chery; Nifty 50 testing 23,950 support
sectors.implications: India's capital inflow resilience is a relative strength signal. EV export competition signals China's manufacturing dominance expanding.

market_outlook.short_term: Markets remain volatile and risk-averse. US-Iran strikes near Hormuz keep oil elevated, pressuring equities and bonds simultaneously. Fed hawkishness (Barr's rate-hike signal) caps equity multiples. Expect choppy, range-bound trading with sharp intraday swings. Tech rotation from chips to software continues. Yen intervention risk adds FX noise. 1-3 month outlook: cautious, defensive posture warranted.
market_outlook.long_term: If Iran conflict de-escalates within 60-90 days, oil normalizes and rate-hike pressure eases, enabling equity recovery. AI capex cycle (security, infrastructure, software) remains structurally intact. India's capital market deepening and EV export competition signal EM manufacturing shift. Inflation may moderate by Q1 2027 if energy stabilizes. 6-12 month outlook: constructive but contingent on geopolitical resolution.
